name: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus Cloud
description: CRUD connector for ServiceDesk Plus Cloud API v3 requests and changes.

tools.name: create_request
tools.documentation: Create a service desk request. The response includes request_id_for_updates, which is the internal ID to use for later updates.

tools.name: update_request
tools.documentation: Update a service desk request using either the internal ID or the displayed request number.

tools.name: get_request
tools.documentation: Get a service desk request using either the internal ID or the displayed request number.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.documentation: List service desk requests. Responses include request_id_for_updates values for later update/delete calls.

tools.name: delete_request
tools.documentation: Delete a service desk request using either the internal ID or the displayed request number.
